Pree, I found two Marrow Agrisupply sites in #central-team. Both come from the 9 June 2026 thread about the stalled rollout:

1. **Eastbank**: Hollis Mbeki (10:46 AM) said the Eastbank receiving-door import is attached to ticket PD-4821. The file labels doors E1/E2, but the booking sheet uses 01/02, so it needs fixing before anyone reimports and creates duplicates.
2. **Pine Crossing**: You (10:48 AM) said the morning receiver sees only the afternoon shift in the appointment screen. A driver arrived at 7:10 the day before and his trailer number was written on a sticky note.

The channel doesn't name the other stores. Hollis mentioned three tracker rows that just say "waiting," but the tracker itself isn't in the channel, so those stores aren't on this list. The Zoom office-hours link mentioned in the 2025 thread is a meeting link, not a site.

I also read #central-random and #inc-tansley-carrier-api while checking, since you're a member of both. Neither mentions Marrow Agrisupply sites.
